import os
import smtplib
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from email.message import EmailMessage
import requests
API = 'https://api.dns-host.example.com/v2'
H = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['DNS_ADMIN_TOKEN']}

def delegate_zone_admin_access(zone: str, user_email: str, role: str, expires_days: int) -> dict:
    exp = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(days=expires_days)).isoformat()
    r = requests.post(f'{API}/zones/{zone}/members', json={'email': user_email, 'role': role, 'expires_at': exp}, headers=H, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    grant = r.json()
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'dns-admin@example.com'
    msg['To'] = user_email
    msg['Subject'] = f'You now have {role} access to {zone}'
    msg.set_content(f'You were granted the {role} role on the DNS zone {zone}.\nThis access expires on {exp}.\nManage the zone: https://dns-host.example.com/zones/{zone}\n')
    with smtplib.SMTP(os.environ.get('SMTP_HOST', 'localhost'), 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login(os.environ['SMTP_USER'], os.environ['SMTP_PASS'])
        s.send_message(msg)
    # Remove older, superseded memberships for this user on the zone
    lst = requests.get(f'{API}/zones/{zone}/members', params={'email': user_email}, headers=H, timeout=30)
    lst.raise_for_status()
    for m in lst.json().get('members', []):
        if m['id'] != grant['id']:
            requests.delete(f"{API}/zones/{zone}/members/{m['id']}", headers=H, timeout=30).raise_for_status()
    return {'zone': zone, 'member_id': grant['id'], 'role': role, 'expires_at': exp}
